items.title: A sheaf presented by finite data on a spectral space comes from a finite sober quotient
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a sheaf of sets on a spectral space which is presented by finite data as in the labelled equation is the pullback of a sheaf with finite stalks along a continuous spectral map to a finite sober space (author lemma at source lines 3276-3286, label lemma-constructible-comes-from-finite). The proof (source lines 3288-3347) writes the space as a directed limit of finite sober spaces, descends the finitely many opens and the two finite families of maps defining the presentation to a stage of the limit, and takes the finite sober space of that stage with the coequaliser of the descended maps as the required sheaf (proof lines 3289-3346). The descent of the finite data to a stage is the content; the author closes with the remark that some details are omitted. H3.
